description: Source code for credential storage management in Git, including functions for parsing, storing, removing, and retrieving credentials, as well as command-line interface handling.

methods.name: parse_credential_file
methods.description: Parses a credential file, matching credentials and executing callbacks.

methods.name: print_entry
methods.description: Prints username and password of a credential.

methods.name: print_line
methods.description: Outputs a line buffer to the credential file with locking.

methods.name: rewrite_credential_file
methods.description: Rewrites the credential file with optional extra data, handling locking.

methods.name: is_rfc3986_unreserved
methods.description: Checks if a character is an unreserved character per RFC 3986.

methods.name: is_rfc3986_reserved_or_unreserved
methods.description: Checks if a character is reserved or unreserved per RFC 3986.

methods.name: store_credential_file
methods.description: Stores a credential into a file in URL format.

methods.name: store_credential
methods.description: Stores credential in the specified files after validation.

methods.name: remove_credential
methods.description: Removes credential entries from specified files.

methods.name: lookup_credential
methods.description: Looks up credentials from files and prints them.

methods.name: cmd_credential_store
methods.description: Main command handler for credential store operations (get, store, erase).
